executionArgs.additionalInstruction: Backend FastAPI running on http://localhost:8000. Auth: POST /register {username,password,email}, POST /login {username,password,remember_me}, POST /logout, GET /me. Image endpoints require Bearer token: POST /images (multipart field name 'file'), POST /images/{image_id}/transform (body may be transformations dict), GET /images/{image_id}, DELETE /images/{image_id}. Use register to obtain token.
